assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors turn a defined enzymatic chemistry, cytidine and engineered adenosine deamination on a Cas-bound single-stranded DNA window, into a general tool for single-nucleotide change without double-strand breaks. The mechanism is chemically explicit, the tool is used everywhere, and it is already in clinical translation.
assessment.attribution: Liu's laboratory made the decisive, conceptually unifying contribution, and Komor and Gaudelli did the experimental work as trainees; a prize would conventionally credit the principal investigator. Kondo and Nishida independently reported a deaminase-based editor (Target-AID), so priority is not fully singular.
assessment.maturity: Independent reproduction is extensive, with thousands of uses and clinical trials, and the interpretation is stable. Recognition is timely, though the overlap with CRISPR (Nobel 2020) and with prime editing (B049) means the committee must treat it as a distinct chemistry-driven advance.
uncertainties: Whether the committee would prefer to recognise base and prime editing together under one laureate.
Whether the Nishida/Kondo parallel work deserves a share.
Clinical durability of edited therapies is still emerging.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chemically induced proximity that hijacks the ubiquitin-proteasome system to degrade targets, with molecular glue degraders explaining the thalidomide mechanism through cereblon. It gives biologists a general chemical tool and opens the undruggable proteome; the mechanism is a defined chemical event.
assessment.attribution: Crews originated and developed the PROTAC concept and Deshaies contributed early work and degrader development; Handa's group identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which anchors the molecular glue half. Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and others made strong contributions, so a three-person limit forces hard choices.
assessment.maturity: Many independent groups and many clinical-stage degraders, but no approved PROTAC drug yet, so clinical vindication is incomplete. Mechanistic understanding of ternary complexes is maturing.
uncertainties: Compound discovery: PROTACs and molecular glues may need different recognition.
Credit allocation among Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli, Gray and Handa is contested.
Absence so far of an approved degrader.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The discovery that a single chemical modification on mRNA is added, removed and read by dedicated proteins reframed post-transcriptional regulation as reversible RNA chemistry, much as DNA and histone modification did. It is a case where biology became a defined enzymatic reaction.
assessment.attribution: Jia and He established FTO as an m6A demethylase and He drove the writer-eraser-reader framework; Dominissini and Rechavi and Meyer and Jaffrey independently mapped m6A transcriptome-wide in 2012. Credit across seven names is intricate and not easily split into three.
assessment.maturity: Broad confirmation of the machinery and mapping, but quantification, stoichiometry and the specificity of antibody and enzyme-based mapping methods remain debated. As a measurement-focused scientist I would want independent quantitative confirmation of function in specific transcripts.
uncertainties: Contested stoichiometry and mapping accuracy of m6A sites.
Whether FTO is a physiologically dominant m6A demethylase.
Seven credited names, with the 2012 mapping and 2011 eraser discovery as separate achievements.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Experiments with ruthenium-modified proteins quantified distance and driving-force dependence of electron transfer and established tunnelling pathways and hopping through aromatic residues. This is directly relevant to radical transfer in enzymes such as ribonucleotide reductase, which I know closely, and is a clean chemical-physical result.
assessment.attribution: Gray and Winkler have jointly carried the programme for decades, with a clear two-person core. Marcus has already been recognised for the underlying theory, which leaves the experimental biological demonstration to Gray and Winkler.
assessment.maturity: Decades of confirmation and replication in many laboratories, so maturity is high. The risk is that recognition is thought to be overlapped by the Marcus prize and appears to be a late acknowledgment.
uncertainties: Whether the committee sees this as a sufficiently distinct advance from Marcus theory.
Relative roles of Gray, Winkler and other collaborators such as Bjerrum and Dutton are not detailed in the supplied text.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Mass-spectrometry proteomics made quantitative, system-wide measurement of proteins, modifications and interactions routine, turning cell biology into measured chemistry. As a person who values rigorous quantification, I see its impact as very large and lasting.
assessment.attribution: Mann, Aebersold and Yates are the usual core trio for shotgun, quantitative and targeted proteomics. Hunt, Gygi and Heck also made foundational contributions, so exclusion is hard to defend.
assessment.maturity: Technology is mature and widely reproduced. The 2002 Nobel for ionisation methods overlaps partly, and some may ask whether this is an application of that work rather than a new chemical principle.
uncertainties: Overlap with the prior ionisation prize.
Many strong contributors beyond three, including Hunt, Gygi, Heck.
Whether it counts as a chemistry discovery or a method area.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing-by-synthesis with reversible terminator nucleotides is a chemical solution that created the modern genomic era. The nucleotide chemistry is central to the invention, and its impact on biology and medicine is huge.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded the Solexa chemistry and platform; Rothberg's pyrosequencing-based approach and Ju's work on terminators and Mayer's work add credit questions. The decisive chemical contributors are clear but contested by commercial history.
assessment.maturity: Over two decades of use with unquestioned confirmation. Timeliness is good, although Sanger sequencing was already recognised and the committee may view this as incremental on an earlier prize.
uncertainties: Credit across competing platforms and companies.
Relation to the earlier Sanger recognition and to medicine/physiology categories.
Whether Rothberg or Ju should displace one of the credited pair.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase carries out the difficult reduction of dinitrogen under ambient conditions, and structural work on the FeMo-cofactor, including the central carbide and substrate-bound states, has described a metalloenzyme mechanism of fundamental importance. It is the kind of mechanism-under-biology question I value.
assessment.attribution: Rees solved the first structures and led cofactor work, Einsle contributed the high-resolution cofactor structure and carbide assignment, and Seefeldt and Dean contributed mechanism and biochemistry; Ribbe contributed assembly. The split between structure and mechanism is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Despite decades of work the catalytic mechanism and the substrate-binding sites are still debated, which lowers maturity. Recent cryo-EM and time-resolved data are promising but not decisive.
uncertainties: The catalytic mechanism is not settled.
Unresolved credit distribution between structural and mechanistic contributors.
Whether the field is premature for recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase and tRNA pairs add genetically encoded unnatural amino acids to proteins in living cells. It is a general tool that gives biologists chemical control over protein residues, built on a clear chemical logic.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang established the first eukaryotic and bacterial systems, Chin extended it to multi-site and quadruplet codons and to eukaryotes, and Mehl and Yokoyama also contributed; the sort of subset that best represents the field is uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Widely replicated across laboratories and used by many, but therapeutic applications are still emerging. Timing is reasonable though not urgent.
uncertainties: Credit among five credited names.
Overlap of Wang's contribution with Schultz's laboratory work.
Limited approved applications so far.
